news.title: Bitcoin erases post-election gains as Wall Street selloff triggers over $1 billion in crypto liquidations
news.summary: Bitcoin fell 6% to $75,700 and ether 7% as a Nasdaq selloff hit crypto, triggering $1.03 billion in liquidations.

news.title: OpenAI Promises to Foot AI’s Power Bill After Voter Revolt. Who Enforces It?
news.summary: OpenAI wants to ease the backlash against AI campuses with promises on electricity, water and secrecy. Its new compact raises a tougher question: Who would make the company comply?

news.title: DOJ Creates 'Super Intelligence' Task Force to Guard Against AI Abuse
news.summary: Led by two senior DOJ officials, the Super Intelligence Task Force will target misuse by foreign governments, criminal groups and fraudsters—while pushing AI developers to tighten internal controls so their systems “behave as intended.”

news.title: Mercado Bitcoin Said Its Hack Was Contained, But Blockchain Data Tells a Different Story
news.summary: Fresh forensic analysis traces $48.6 million across 11 blockchains and finds thousands of customer deposit addresses drained hours after the Brazilian exchange said it had stopped the breach on Monday.

news.title: Crypto ally French Hill wins reelection but set to lose House chair
news.summary: Republican French Hill secured another term in Congress but will lose his leadership of the House Financial Services Committee when Democrats take control in January.
